nodes.question: What are some of the primary focuses of environmental strategies within the healthcare sector?
nodes.answer: Environmental strategies within the healthcare sector typically focus on waste reduction, reduction in energy use, and emissions.
nodes.paragraph: Environmental strategies within the healthcare sector typically focus on waste reduction in addition to reduction in energy use and emissions (Thiel et al. 2015). For instance, minimizing the use of single-use devices in favour of reus- able alternatives is one of the mitigation strategies created by hospitals (Unger and Landis 2016). In addition to the direct impacts, the indirect impacts arise from the use of these devices, which include favour - able effects on the optimization of healthcare procedures and adverse impacts arising from the additional demand for resources. For example, advances in electronic surgi - cal devices have introduced new surgical techniques and diagnostic modalities in medical institutions (Gautam and Sahney 2020). These devices have favoured the use of less invasive procedures leading to shorter hospital stays for patients (Yu et al. 2012). Therefore, it is important to have a comprehensive evaluation of the environmental sustainabil- ity of these devices, because these positive impacts might compensate for the increased environmental damage associ- ated with the life cycle stages (Frag o-Marques and Ozben 2022).
